class.name: Terrain3D
class.brief_description: Displays an editable heightmap as a 3D mesh.
class.description: [Terrain3D] is a 3D node that owns a [TerrainHeightmap] and renders it as an indexed mesh. When [member terrain_data] changes, the generated mesh automatically updates, including in the editor. The base class's mesh property contains the generated mesh, not a separate source of terrain information. Terrain textures can be blended using the vertex colors generated by [method TerrainHeightmap.build_mesh]. This experimental node does not implement interactive editor brushes, collision, chunked LOD or world streaming.

method.name: rebuild
method.description: Explicitly rebuilds the mesh from [member terrain_data], if set.

members.member: The distance in world units between neighboring heightmap vertices. Must be finite and greater than zero.
The editable terrain heightmap resource. By default a 17x17 heightmap is created for new nodes. The node listens for [signal Resource.changed] and rebuilds its mesh when this resource changes.
